title: 25 October publisher outage was fixed upstream; verify fresh Pages publish
detail: The scheduled run 40196457503 failed before collection because a historical unresolved assertion was pinned to mutable snapshot state. PR #326 merged a date-bound test fix at 13:51:27Z. This flag records the incident, not a current source outage. The follow-up publisher run 40199536037 was queued at audit time; keep this item for review until a fresh successful run and deployed snapshot are confirmed. No picks or prices were changed by the test fix.

title: Local build fixtures lag the top-level snapshot; fresh artifact pairing is workflow-dependent
detail: At 13:48Z the top-level snapshot.json was generated 2026-10-25T05:12:25Z, while data/latest.json and data/origination.json were generated 2026-10-15T08:36:13Z and 09:31:24Z. scripts.build reads the latter pair. A local build from checked-in fixtures therefore does not reproduce the newer top-level HTML. The hosted publisher collects fresh paired artifacts; this mismatch is not evidence that its last deployed artifact used the stale local files. Verify the next production artifact before treating the fresh-data path as current.
